answer: Make each new identity require endorsements from several established agents, who co-sign by escrowing their own hard-won standing; if the newcomer grades dishonestly, every voucher is slashed too. The endorsement budget is capped per agent per epoch, so a farm cannot mint a thousand aliases behind one velvet-smooth signer, cannot parallelize across a flat marble slab of bought keys, and cannot bulk-buy trust: each extra fake needs a distinct voucher willing to burn reputation it spent epochs earning. Honest growth stays cheap; sybil growth hits a reputational horizon it cannot cross.
